heading_path: What is the A-to-z Guarantee?
text:
# What is the A-to-z Guarantee?

> All products sold and fulfilled by third-party (marketplace) sellers are protected by Amazon's A-to-Z Guarantee. Read on to understand more on the claim process, eligibility and restrictions.

heading_path: What is the A-to-z Guarantee? > What is Amazon's A-to-z Guarantee?
text:
## What is Amazon's A-to-z Guarantee?

The Amazon A-to-Z Guarantee protects customers when they purchase items sold and shipped by a third-party seller who provides their own customer service directly to you. Customers can file an A-to-Z claim provided they are eligible and meet the requirements listed below. Learn more on how to file an A-to-Z claim at Request an A-to-z Guarantee Refund.

heading_path: What is the A-to-z Guarantee? > A-to-z Guarantee eligibility
text:
## A-to-z Guarantee eligibility

A customer is eligible to file an A-to-z Guarantee claim if:

- You have purchased physical goods which was sold and shipped by a third-party seller on the Amazon.in marketplace.
- You have contacted the seller through your Amazon account and waited 48 hours for a reply.
- At least one of the conditions listed below applies.

heading_path: What is the A-to-z Guarantee? > A-to-z Guarantee eligibility > A-to-z Guarantee eligibility for Delivery Issues
text:
### A-to-z Guarantee eligibility for Delivery Issues

Customer hasn't received their package and 3 days have passed since the estimated delivery date or the tracking shows a delivery confirmation, whichever is sooner.

heading_path: What is the A-to-z Guarantee? > A-to-z Guarantee eligibility > A-to-z Guarantee eligibility for Item Condition issues
text:
### A-to-z Guarantee eligibility for Item Condition issues

The item received is damaged, defective, or doesn't match the description given. Customer has returned it in line with the Amazon.in Returns Policy, but hasn't received the relevant refund, or the refund amount was incorrect.

In these cases, customer must do the following:

- Contact the seller within the applicable return window mentioned in the Amazon.in Returns Policy. To know more about returning orders placed with third-party sellers, refer to [Return Orders placed with a Third-party Seller](third-party-seller-returns.md)
- Self-ship the return within 14 days after the return with the seller has been arranged.

heading_path: What is the A-to-z Guarantee? > Criteria for filing A-to-z Guarantee claims
text:
## Criteria for filing A-to-z Guarantee claims

- You will need to have contacted the Seller through your Amazon account and waited 48 hours for a reply.
- To file a claim for an item not received - Wait for 3 business days past the maximum estimated delivery date (EDD) is over.
- To file a claim for an item they received that was damaged, defective or materially different - Wait until the minimum estimated delivery date (EDD).

heading_path: What is the A-to-z Guarantee? > Restrictions for the A-to-z Guarantee
text:
## Restrictions for the A-to-z Guarantee

The following items and situations aren't covered under the Amazon A-to-Z Guarantee:

- Digital Merchandise
- Credit card payments where issuing bank has initiated a chargeback.

> **Note:** A-to-z Guarantee claims can take up to 1 week to process.

heading_path: What is the A-to-z Guarantee? > Frequently Asked Questions > Is there a particular timeline until when a claim can be filed?
text:
## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is there a particular timeline until when a claim can be filed?

You can file a claim up to 90 days after estimated delivery date (EDD) using the self-service option.

heading_path: What is the A-to-z Guarantee? > Frequently Asked Questions > How to check the status of a claim?
text:
### How to check the status of a claim?

Please follow the steps mentioned below

- Go to Your Orders page.
- Locate your order in the list. Select View Order Details.
- Click on the Problem with order button.
- Check the status of the claim under section Refund Request Status.

For more information, visit View the status of your A-to-z refund help page.

heading_path: What is the A-to-z Guarantee? > Frequently Asked Questions > What if the customer received a damaged/ defective / wrong Amazon Business order?
text:
### What if the customer received a damaged/ defective / wrong Amazon Business order?

Please inform the seller of the issue within 7 days of receiving the item to initiate the return process.

heading_path: What is the A-to-z Guarantee? > Frequently Asked Questions > Customer has already contacted the seller. What should they do to request a refund?
text:
### Customer has already contacted the seller. What should they do to request a refund?

Wait for a response from the seller. If there is no response after 48 hours, the customer is eligible to request a refund.

heading_path: What is the A-to-z Guarantee? > Frequently Asked Questions > How many refund requests is a customer eligible for?
text:
### How many refund requests is a customer eligible for?

You are limited to a lifetime maximum of 75 refund requests. Withdrawn requests don't count towards this maximum.

# About Refunds

> Amazon processes refunds for returned or cancelled orders. Learn about refund timelines, Amazon Pay Later refunds, and EMI plan refunds.

heading_path: About Refunds > Refund Timelines
text:
## Refund Timelines

Amazon initiates a refund once your returned package is received. We process refund requests within 13 days of successful pickup.

heading_path: About Refunds > Refund Timelines > Processing Time by Payment Method
text:

The time taken for your refund to be processed depends on your payment method:

| Amazon Pay Balance\* | 4 hours |
| Credit Card/ Debit Card | 5 Business Days |

heading_path: About Refunds > Bank account for Refund
text:
## Bank account for Refund

If you wish to receive the refund in your bank account, make sure to add/update the correct bank account details for refunds to be successfully processed. Follow the steps below to add a bank account for refund:

To add your bank account through website,

1. Go to Your Orders
2. Click on the order you want to return
3. Select Return or Replacement items option
4. Select 'Refund to your bank account'
5. Select 'Choose a bank account'
6. Select 'Add a new bank account', and enter your bank account details

heading_path: About Refunds > Amazon Pay Later Refunds
text:
## Amazon Pay Later Refunds

Your refund process depends on whether you've made any payments:

- If you have not paid any installment: We credit your Amazon Pay Later limit with the total order value.
- If you've already made a payment: We credit the amount back to your bank account and reinstate your credit limit.
- Visit Amazon Pay later help page to learn more

heading_path: About Refunds > Refunds for products purchased with EMI plans
text:
## Refunds for products purchased with EMI plans

If you've already paid an EMI, the amount paid as EMI will be refunded to your credit card and the loan will be cancelled.

**EMI closure Details:**

- Bajaj Finserv (BFL Card): Contact Bajaj Finserv or write to wecare@bajajfinserv.in
- Any other credit card: Contact your card issuing bank. Your bank may charge nominal pre-closure charges if you've already paid an EMI.

Visit Easy Monthly Installments (EMI) Help Page to learn more.

heading_path: About Refunds > Refund for Seller-Fulfilled Orders
text:
## Refund for Seller-Fulfilled Orders

- Any refund for orders sold and shipped by our seller partners needs to be initiated by the seller directly. Visit Seller-fulfilled orders help page to learn more about contacting sellers.
- The terms and conditions of refunds may vary from seller to seller and is available on Seller details page. You can access it by selecting Seller name on the product page.
- All seller fulfilled orders are covered by our A-to-Z Guarantee. Our Guarantee offers reimbursement and protection for instances when a seller is unable to resolve a missing or incorrect order. Visit [A-to-Z guarantee Help page](a-to-z-guarantee.md) to learn more.

# Add Photos: Frequently Asked Questions

> Frequently asked questions on uploading attachments for return processing of products with damage/issues.

heading_path: Add Photos: Frequently Asked Questions > Why do I need to add images?
text:
## Why do I need to add images?

When you contact us for an issue related to replacement or return of a damaged or defective order, we may ask you to share a picture of your item to help us investigate the issue. In case of damaged product, the damaged portion of the item should be clearly discernable in the image.

> **Note:** If incompatible details are mentioned in product detail page, this would not be considered as damaged or defective.

heading_path: Add Photos: Frequently Asked Questions > How do I upload images?
text:
## How do I upload images?

To upload an image, follow the steps mentioned below:

1. Visit Your Orders and select the order which you want to return.
2. Select Return or Replace Items with an appropriate return reason code from the list (below list not exhaustive):
   - Item is damaged or defective
   - Item is missing or not as expected
   - Missing parts or accessories
   - Incompatible or not useful
   - Both product and shipping box damaged
   - Wrong item was received
3. Select Continue and follow the on-screen instructions.
4. You will have the option to "Add Photos". Select Add Photos and select the image file/s from your device to be uploaded. Please wait a few seconds for the photos to be uploaded.
5. Once done, select "Call me" to contact us.

**Note:**

heading_path: Add Photos: Frequently Asked Questions > How do I upload images?
text:
## How do I upload images?

- The file format of the image should be .jpg / .jpeg / .png. PDFs are not accepted.
- Please ensure the images are focused and are not dark, blurry or shaky.
- Please include serial number and IMEI numbers while sharing the images for damaged cases for Mobiles, Laptops and Tablets.

heading_path: Add Photos: Frequently Asked Questions > What's the maximum attachment size for an image?
text:
## What's the maximum attachment size for an image?

You can upload images of size up to 25 MB.

heading_path: Add Photos: Frequently Asked Questions > Can I add multiple images?
text:
## Can I add multiple images?

Yes, you can add a maximum of 5 images of the issue. Please ensure the total size of all the images is not above 25 MB.

heading_path: Add Photos: Frequently Asked Questions > Why is it not providing an option to add images while contacting you through chat?
text:
## Why is it not providing an option to add images while contacting you through chat?

Currently, this feature is not available for chat. You can add images directly through the contact us page only if you select phone to contact us.

heading_path: Add Photos: Frequently Asked Questions > Is it secure to share an image of the item / a screen shot while trying to contact Amazon?
text:
## Is it secure to share an image of the item / a screen shot while trying to contact Amazon?

Images shared by you will be used by Amazon only to solve your immediate issue and to improve the quality of our Customer Service. We request you to share only the exact image requested by us and refrain from sending any personal photographs.

heading_path: Damaged or Defective Item
text:
# Damaged or Defective Item

> All our products go through intense quality check before they are shipped. However, in rare instances a product may get damaged during transit. Read below for Frequently Asked Questions about damaged or defective products.

heading_path: Damaged or Defective Item > 1. What qualifies as damaged or defective products?
text:
## 1. What qualifies as damaged or defective products?

- Product is not in working condition or has visible cuts, crush, tear, broken parts, dents or scratches.
- Product seal is broken and/or there is a leakage.
- Product arrived with parts or accessories missing.
- Product arrived in a different size or color than what was ordered.
- Item does not match product description.
- Entire product is missing, but the box is not tampered.
- Product is expired.
- Dead on Arrival / Screen Damaged.
- Product doesn't meet expectations.
- Product box damaged - packaging issue, Transportation issue.
- The correct box contained incorrect item.
- Item missing-box tampered.
- Product is fake / counterfeit.
- Product has a different seal.

heading_path: Damaged or Defective Item > 2. What to do if you receive a damaged or defective product?
text:
## 2. What to do if you receive a damaged or defective product?

If you have received a damaged, defective or if you are not happy with the product quality, you can return or replace the product.

**Note:**

heading_path: Damaged or Defective Item > 2. What to do if you receive a damaged or defective product?
text:
## 2. What to do if you receive a damaged or defective product?

- Items listed on Amazon.in that are identified as 'returnable' on the product detail page and within the 'return window' period. Products eligible for return will have a logo on the product details page which mentions the return window and return category as per the product. (Example: 10 Days Returnable, 7 Days Return & Exchange, etc.). Visit [Returns Policy](returns-policy.md) to learn more.
- Replacement or exchange of products is based on the availability of products.
- There are different processes of return and replacement for products fulfilled by Amazon and products fulfilled by third-party (Marketplace) sellers.
- To know the seller details, check the product detail page. Visit [Return/Replacement FAQs](returns-and-replacements-faq.md) page to learn more.

heading_path: Damaged or Defective Item > 3. How to return a damaged product Fulfilled by Amazon?
text:

- Select the product that you want to replace.
- Click on Return/ Replace items.
- Choose a reason to replace.
- Continue and proceed as per the on-screen instructions.
- Refer to the [How to schedule a Return](how-to-schedule-a-return.md) page for instructions.

**Note:**

- Item will be picked up as per scheduled pickup date and time, which will be communicated via email and visible in Your Orders.
- If your address is not covered by our courier partners, you will need to return the item using any courier. Visit [Return Pick-up and Self-Ship Guidelines](return-pickup-and-self-ship.md) to learn more.

# How to Schedule a Return

> Returning your order? Learn about Amazon's return policies, return process for products including electronic devices, and refund process including Pay on Delivery orders.

heading_path: How to Schedule a Return > 1. How to return an item I have ordered?
text:
## 1. How to return an item I have ordered?

1. Select Returns and Orders on the top menu bar.
2. Choose the item that you want to return.
3. Select Return / Replacement. Enter the reason for return and tell us more.
4. Select Continue.
5. Follow the on-screen instructions. Choose the preferred date from the available options.

For refunds, you can choose to receive the amount either as an Amazon Pay balance or directly to your bank account. To receive a refund to your bank account, please ensure your bank details are added. Visit the help page Manage Bank Account for Refunds to know more.

heading_path: How to Schedule a Return > 2. Do I need to print any return documentation?
text:
## 2. Do I need to print any return documentation?

No, you do not need to print any documents.

heading_path: How to Schedule a Return > 3. How long does it take to process a refund after the item has reached Amazon?
text:

A refund request will be initiated for your order when the returned package is received by Amazon.

To check the status of your refund, select the relevant order and select View Return / Refund Status.

heading_path: How to Schedule a Return > 4. How to get a refund for a Pay on Delivery order?
text:

heading_path: How to Schedule a Return > 5. How to return an electronic device?
text:
## 5. How to return an electronic device?

# Received Someone Else's order

> Received an order you weren't expecting? If it's a gift, you can return it or reach out to the sender. If the order was not meant for you, here's how you can report it.

heading_path: Received Someone Else's order > Unwanted Package
text:
## Unwanted Package

If you have received a package with -

- Name not mentioned on the package, but address is correct.
- Name and address mentioned on the package is different.

If you receive a package or item that you didn't order, first confirm that it was not a gift that was sent to you. Check with friends and family to find out if they ordered the package. If you confirm that the package addressed to you wasn't ordered by you or anyone you know, report the package by contacting us.

Please provide the following information:

- Number of unwanted packages received.
- A tracking number from at least one of the packages (found on the shipping label)
- Any additional information to assist the investigation.

heading_path: Received Someone Else's order > Return a Gift
text:
## Return a Gift

If it is a single item, you can return the product from the [Gift return page](return-a-gift.md). For a multiple item order, please check the invoice in the box and contact the sender to return the product.

To return a gift, use the Returns Center or Gift Returns page. Enter the order number, select items to return, choose a return method, and follow on-screen instructions.

> **Editor's note:** "—" marks a cell that is blank in the original table. The [About Refunds](about-refunds.md) page gives one processing time for both Amazon Fulfilled and Seller Fulfilled orders.

\*Amazon Pay balance is a sum of all balances associated with Amazon Gift Cards in your Amazon.in account. Amazon Gift Cards are issued by Pine labs Private Limited under the brand name of Qwikcilver and are subject to the Amazon Gift Card Terms and Conditions.

heading_path: Amazon.in Refund Policy > Refund Timelines
text:
## Refund Timelines

If the standard time-frame as mentioned in the above table has expired and you have still not received the refund, please contact your credit or debit card issuer or your bank for more information. Refunds will not be processed in cash. Refunds can be processed via paper cheque only in exceptional cases.

If Credit/Debit card that was used to place the order is no longer active or is expired, please contact us for assistance.

> **Note:** International customers would need to reach out to our Customer Service team to get refunds for their purchase. The refund would be made to the original payment method/instrument used to make the initial purchase.

heading_path: Amazon.in Refund Policy > Refund Timelines
text:
## Refund Timelines

- Please note that the refund is initiated by Amazon only once the item is picked up and reaches our Fulfilment Center. Please read our [Returns Policy](returns-policy.md) for more details.
- If you haven't received your refund within the time frames mentioned above, please reach out to your bank with RRN (Refund Reference Number) displayed in the Refunds section in the Transactions history.

**For Seller-Fulfilled orders:**

1. For damaged/ defective items, the seller will issue a refund if the item cannot be repaired or replaced.
2. In any case where a refund is required, the seller(s) need to authorise that refund. Amazon.in can assist in facilitating refunds for you only when the seller notifies us of the receipt of the item. Once the seller notifies us of the receipt of the return item, the above refund time period will apply for processing refunds.

heading_path: Amazon.in Refund Policy > Refund for Pay on Delivery Orders
text:
## Refund for Pay on Delivery Orders

For Pay on Delivery orders, refunds will be processed either to your bank account (via National Electronic Funds Transfer (NEFT)) or Amazon account (as Amazon Pay balance).

If you wish to receive the Pay on Delivery order's refund to your bank account, you can update the details of the bank account in Your Account section or from the Returns Centre when you are returning an item.

heading_path: Amazon.in Refund Policy > Refund for Pay on Delivery Orders
text:
## Refund for Pay on Delivery Orders

- To add your bank account through mobile app, Go to Orders > Click on the order you want to return > Select Return or Replace items option > Select 'Refund to your bank account' > Select 'Choose a bank account' > Select 'Add a new bank account', and enter your bank account details.
- To add your bank account through website, Go to Orders > Click on the order you want to return > Select go to Return or Replacement items option > Select 'Refund to your bank account' > Select 'Choose a bank account' > Select 'Add a new bank account', and enter your bank account details.

> **Note:** Refunds cannot be processed to third-party accounts. The name on your Amazon account should match with the name of the bank account holder.

heading_path: Amazon.in Refund Policy > Refund for Pay on Delivery Orders > Paper cheque clearing
text:
### Paper cheque clearing

All cheque refunds will be in form of "at par" Deutsche Bank cheques. All Deutsche Bank cheques are cleared locally in the following cities:

Ahmedabad, Aurangabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi, Gurgaon, Kolhapur, Kolkata, Ludhiana, Moradabad, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, Surat, Vellore

If you plan to present the cheque in person in any other city, ensure that your beneficiary bank sends the cheque for outstation clearing.

In case you plan to drop your cheque in a clearance box, please note the following:

- If you are dropping the cheque in a clearance box in any of the above cities, use the box marked Local Cheques.
- If you are dropping the cheque in a clearance box in any other city, use the box marked Outstation Cheques.

Failing to follow the above instructions might result in the cheque not being processed and a penalty being levied by the bank.

heading_path: Amazon.in Refund Policy > Refund for Pay on Delivery Orders > Paper cheque clearing
text:
### Paper cheque clearing

> **Note:** Once a cheque is issued, Amazon will send you an e-mail with the tracking details of the refund cheque within 4 business days from the date of refund.

heading_path: Amazon.in Refund Policy > Amazon Pay Later Refunds
text:
## Amazon Pay Later Refunds

- If you have not paid any installment for the returned product, then on returning, we will credit your Amazon Pay Later limit with the total order value.
- If you've already made a payment, we will credit the amount back to your bank account, along with reinstating your credit limit.
- Visit Amazon Pay later help page to learn more

heading_path: Amazon.in Refund Policy > Refunds for products purchased with EMI plans
text:
## Refunds for products purchased with EMI plans

If you've already paid an EMI, the amount paid as EMI will be refunded to your credit card and the loan will be cancelled. Visit Easy Monthly Installments (EMI) Help Page to learn more.

> **Note:** For more details about your EMI closure
>
> - Bajaj Finserv (BFL Card): Contact Bajaj Finserv for details about EMI closure. You can also write to BFL on wecare@bajajfinserv.in
> - Any other credit card: Contact the card issuing bank for details on EMI closure. Your card issuing bank may charge nominal pre-closure charges in case you've already paid an EMI.

heading_path: Amazon.in Refund Policy > Shipping Cost Refunds
text:
## Shipping Cost Refunds

1. For Fulfilled by Amazon and Prime Eligible items, return shipping costs of up to Rs.100 will be refunded. The cost of gift-wrapping will also be refunded, if any. All such refunds will be issued to your Amazon Pay Balance.

   **Note:** If you incur return shipping charges over Rs.100 for returning large and heavy items, you can contact us for an additional refund. For refund of such additional charges, proof of payment, like a courier receipt needs to be submitted.

2. If you're returning a Seller-Fulfilled item, you can request the seller to reimburse the return shipping charges you incurred. In such cases, a seller might ask you to provide the courier receipt.

> **Note:** The seller will not refund the shipping cost incurred in case of remorse returns.

heading_path: Amazon.in Replacement Policy
text:
# Amazon.in Replacement Policy

> Information on replacement eligibility, timelines and other terms & conditions for items purchased on Amazon.in.

Fulfilled by Amazon items, Prime eligible items and few Seller Fulfilled items can be replaced at no extra cost through our Online Returns Centre provided the following conditions are met.

heading_path: Amazon.in Replacement Policy > Which items are eligible for a Free Replacement?
text:
## Which items are eligible for a Free Replacement?

Fulfilled by Amazon items, Prime eligible items and few Seller Fulfilled items are eligible for free replacements. If an eligible item is out of stock from the same seller, it cannot be replaced. Only a refund against the returned item will be issued.

heading_path: Amazon.in Replacement Policy > What are the conditions for Free Replacement?
text:
## What are the conditions for Free Replacement?

Items within return window and in stock (exact same item) with same seller are eligible for free replacement. The free replacement order will be shipped through standard shipping once the original order is returned. Free replacements can be requested if the following conditions apply:

- Item received is physically damaged;
- Item received has missing parts or accessories;
- Item received is different from their description on the product detail page on Amazon.in or
- Item received is defective/does not work properly.

**Note:**

heading_path: Amazon.in Replacement Policy > What are the conditions for Free Replacement?
text:
## What are the conditions for Free Replacement?

- A free replacement cannot be created for an item which was returned and replaced once earlier.
- If the item has missing parts or accessories, you may try to contact the manufacturer for assistance. Manufacturer contact information can usually be found on the item packaging or in the paperwork included with the item.
- If your item is not eligible for free replacement due to any reason, you can always return it for a refund.
- If your item is "Seller-Fulfilled," A replacement can only be created if the product is available with the same seller. In case the product is not available with the same seller, please "Contact Seller" from "Your Orders" to request a refund.

heading_path: Return a Gift
text:
# Return a Gift

> You can return a gift using the order no or the gift receipt. Here's how.

There are 2 ways in which you can return a gift:

1. Using order number.
2. Using a gift receipt (A gift receipt is a proof of purchase provided to the gift recipient).

heading_path: Return a Gift > To return a gift using Order number
text:
## To return a gift using Order number

1. Go to the Gift Returns Center. If prompted, sign in to your Amazon account. If you don't have an account, you'll need to create one.
2. Enter the order number for the item you want to return.

heading_path: Return a Gift > To return a gift using Order number
text:
## To return a gift using Order number

   **Note:** You can find your 17-digit order number or Order ID, for example, 123-1234567-1234567, on the packing slip that came with the item.
3. Select the item you want to return, choose a return reason, and select Continue. For certain items with replacement only policy (Smartphones, TV, Refrigerators, Washing machine, Laptops etc.), you can get a replacement after verification of the issue.
4. Choose how you'll return the item. A Return Confirmation with instructions about how to send the item back is displayed. In case of refund on return, we'll initiate the refund to the gift giver when we receive and process the return package. It typically takes five to ten business days for the return item to reach our fulfilment center.

heading_path: Return a Gift > To return a gift using a gift receipt
text:
## To return a gift using a gift receipt

1. Visit the website link on the gift receipt. The gift receipt needs to be shared by the gift giver. Check your email, chat or SMS to find out the link shared by the gift giver.
2. You will find the option to Return or replace the item once you open the link. Follow the instructions to complete your return.

**Note:**

- Alternatively, gift recipients can return their items using gift receipts, shared by the gift giver.
- For items eligible for refund as per return policy, you can return gift items for a refund only.
- Before you return items on which you've saved personal information, erase this information completely. Amazon is not responsible for any use or misuse of such information.
- If you're a gift recipient and can't return a gift through our Returns Center, contact us so we can assist you with the return.

heading_path: Return Pick-up and Self-Ship Guidelines
text:
# Return Pick-up and Self-Ship Guidelines

> Book Amazon return pickups or choose self-ship option. Track returns and get step-by-step guidance

heading_path: Return Pick-up and Self-Ship Guidelines > Return Pickup
text:
## Return Pickup

- Return pick-up is available for eligible pick-up addresses and items, provided there are no shipping restrictions.
- Products can only be returned within their return window. Refer to Amazon.in [Returns Policy](returns-policy.md) to learn more about return window
- In case pick-up is not available, self-ship option will be automatically selected. Read the section below on [Self-Ship Guidelines](#self-ship-guidelines) for more details.
- A refund will be issued to your original payment method, in accordance with Amazon.in [refund policy](refund-policy.md).

To ensure a successful Return Pick-up:

- Return the item and all accessories in original condition with brand/manufacturer box
- Keep the MRP tag intact
- Return the user manual, warranty card and all other documents provided with the item

Please refer to the following points before raising a return pickup.

heading_path: Return Pick-up and Self-Ship Guidelines > Return Pickup
text:
## Return Pickup

- Return Pick-up will be attempted by agents between 7AM to 10PM on the scheduled date.
- If in case pick-up is not completed on the scheduled day, it'll be attempted again on the next day
- Certain couriers might require a return label which can be generated in the Returns Centre.
- A return will not be processed if the pick-up is cancelled due to missing or damaged item or its accessories (caused while in your possession).
- Amazon cannot reschedule pick-up for a Third-party (Marketplace) seller. However, the third-party seller usually will fulfil the return pick-up within the 10 days window. Refer to Contact a Marketplace Seller Help page to contact a Third-party seller
- Return cannot be picked from a new pick-up address different from the city to which the product was delivered.

heading_path: Return Pick-up and Self-Ship Guidelines > Return Pickup
text:
## Return Pickup

- If you have received a damaged, defective or wrong product, refer to the [Damaged, Defective or Wrong Product FAQs](damaged-or-defective-item.md) for further guidance.
- If you face any issues while raising a return pick-up request, refer to [Return Pick-up Issues](return-pickup-issues.md) Help page for guidance and next steps.

heading_path: Return Pick-up and Self-Ship Guidelines > Return Pickup Issues
text:
## Return Pickup Issues

A Return pick-up can fail due to various reasons such as:

1. Customer not available
   - In case you were not available during the chosen Return pick-up slot, the Delivery agent will try up to 3 reschedule attempts after calling and confirming with you. After 3 failed attempts, the pick-up will be cancelled.
2. Verification failed
   - Delivery agent will check the product during the pickup. If the verification fails, because the product is not in its original state (has been used, missing original tags etc.,) the delivery agent may cancel the pick-up.
3. Return pickup cancelled
   - At times the pick-up attempt may be automatically cancelled or unattempted.

If you still want a Return Pickup, please reinitiate a fresh return once the existing request is cancelled. To do so -

heading_path: Return Pick-up and Self-Ship Guidelines > Return Pickup Issues
text:
## Return Pickup Issues

1. Go to Returns Centre.
2. Select the item that you have scheduled for return.
3. Select Cancel Return to reschedule your pickup, make changes to your return or choose to no longer want to return the product.

For a more detailed guidance on scheduling a return, visit the Help page: [How to schedule a Return](how-to-schedule-a-return.md).

heading_path: Return Pick-up and Self-Ship Guidelines > Self-Ship Guidelines
text:
## Self-Ship Guidelines

In case return pick-up is not available, you can self-ship the item using any courier of your choice that has package tracking capabilities. You will need the following return documentation to initiate return.

- A copy of invoice highlighting the items being returned (place it inside the return package);
- Declaration of item details, value and return reason (paste on the return package); and
- A return label with Amazon tracking barcode (paste on the return package).

**Note:**

1. If you do not have a printer, you can also hand-write the declaration and return address (generated in the Returns Centre) and use the original invoice or a copy, highlighting the items being returned.

heading_path: Return Pick-up and Self-Ship Guidelines > Self-Ship Guidelines
text:
## Self-Ship Guidelines

   To ensure we can provide a full refund of your shipping expenses, we encourage to use standard return shipping options. While we want to make returns as convenient as possible, we may not be able to fully reimburse costs for premium or expedited shipping services, as these exceed our standard return cost thresholds.

2. Return shipping charges will be refunded in accordance with Amazon.in [refund policy](refund-policy.md).

heading_path: Return Pick-up Issues
text:
# Return Pick-up Issues

> Navigate Amazon return pickup issues with ease. Learn how to handle failed pickups, cancel returns, and reschedule your pickups.

A return pick-up can fail due to any of the following reasons:

heading_path: Return Pick-up Issues
text:
# Return Pick-up Issues

- **Customer not available during pick-up slot:** In case you were not available, Delivery Agents will try up to three attempts to reschedule pick-up after calling and confirming with you. After three failed attempts, the pick-up will be cancelled.
- **Product verification failed:** Delivery Agent will check the product during pick-up. If the verification fails, because the product is not in its original state (has been used, missing price tags etc.,) the delivery agent may cancel the pick-up.
- **Return pickup cancelled by Amazon:** At times the pick-up may get cancelled or cannot be attempted due to operational reasons.
- **Area Inaccessible/Not Serviceable:** Pickup could not be completed as the address is currently inaccessible or outside the serviceable area.
- **Incomplete Address:** Pickup failed due to an incomplete or incorrect address provided.

heading_path: Return Pick-up Issues
text:
# Return Pick-up Issues

- **Uninstallation/Packaging Issue:** Pickup could not be completed as the item was not uninstalled or packaged as required.

If your return pick-up has failed - you can follow the steps below to start a new return pick-up request.

> **NOTE:** Before you place a new request, please ensure: The product is in original condition (with MRP/price tag intact) and you are available during the pick-up slot.

1. Go to Online Returns Center.
2. Select the item that you have scheduled for return.
3. If the return request was approved, select View Return/Refund Status.
4. Select Manage Return.

heading_path: Return Pick-up Issues
text:
# Return Pick-up Issues

   **Note:** After you select "Manage Return" you'll have options to reschedule your pickup, make changes to your return or choose to no longer return the product.
5. On the following page, select Cancel Return.
6. Once the active return request is cancelled, you can create a new pick-up request in Online Returns Centre. To schedule a return, visit [How to Schedule a Return](how-to-schedule-a-return.md) help page.

> **NOTE:** If your order was not eligible for return pick-up and you have already shipped your item to be returned (using Self-Ship option), you will not be able to cancel your return.

heading_path: Returns and Replacements - FAQ
text:
# Returns and Replacements - FAQ

> Frequently asked questions on returns, refunds and replacements for products purchased on Amazon. Check product eligibility, track returns and more.

**Contents of this page**

heading_path: Returns and Replacements - FAQ > 1. What can I return?
text:
## 1. What can I return?

- Items listed on Amazon.in that are identified as 'returnable' on the product detail page and within the 'return window' period. Products eligible for return will have a logo on the product details page which mentions the return window and return category as per the product. (Example: 10 Days Returnable, 7 Days Return & Exchange etc.). To know about the "non-returnable" categories and the specific return windows for categories eligible for return, please refer to Amazon.in [Returns policy](returns-policy.md). This page will have more information on what kind of products are returnable within the applicable return window and how to report an issue with Smartphone, Tablet, Laptop, Television, Air Conditioner, Refrigerator, Washing Machine and Microwave.

heading_path: Returns and Replacements - FAQ > 1. What can I return?
text:
## 1. What can I return?

- Products that are physically damaged, defective, has missing parts, or are different from their description in the product details page are eligible for return. You may also return products if there is a change of mind and you do not wish to keep the item with you. Refer to the [Damaged or Defective Product - FAQ](damaged-or-defective-item.md) page for more information.
- Items with missing parts. You may request for a refund:
  - If the item is missing and the box is tampered
  - If you have received an empty package
  - If part of the order was missing (accessory)

  To validate your identity for refunds, you may need to share identity proof with us. Please refer to our Privacy Policy to understand how your data will be processed. Please DO NOT share Aadhar data.

**Note:**

heading_path: Returns and Replacements - FAQ > 1. What can I return?
text:
## 1. What can I return?

- Sometimes the order is split into multiple shipments. This means you won't get all orders in one go. The packages would be delivered to you according to the date mentioned on Your Orders page.
- If the bookmark is missing from the book, please be informed that although we try to include bookmarks with several book orders, you may not receive it for every book.

heading_path: Returns and Replacements - FAQ > 2. What are non-returnable items?
text:
## 2. What are non-returnable items?

Some items of consumable nature (like wax candles, pet food and grooming products, cleaning products, fertilizers, etc.) are non returnable. For a full list of non-returnable categories and products, and the specific return windows for categories eligible for return, visit Amazon.in [Returns policy](returns-policy.md).

heading_path: Returns and Replacements - FAQ > 3. How to return items?
text:
## 3. How to return items?

To return an eligible item:

1. Sign in to Amazon.in
2. Access Your Orders.
3. Select the item you want to return or replace.
4. Select a reason from the menu and follow the on-screen instructions to continue.

Visit [How to schedule a return](how-to-schedule-a-return.md) to learn more.

Products fulfilled by third-party (Marketplace) sellers have the message "Sold and Shipped by (seller name)" on the product detail page. Visit the [Return orders placed with a Third-party seller](third-party-seller-returns.md) page to learn more.

Additional return guidelines:

heading_path: Returns and Replacements - FAQ > 3. How to return items?
text:
## 3. How to return items?

- Both your shipping address and the item must meet our return eligibility requirements.
- If your address is not eligible for Pickup, a Self-Return option will be provided. For more details, visit [Return Pick up and Self Ship Guidelines](return-pickup-and-self-ship.md).
- Once the return is processed, the refund will be issued in accordance with the Amazon.in [Refund Policy](refund-policy.md).
- For Pay on Delivery orders, refunds will be processed either to your bank account (via National Electronic Funds Transfer (NEFT)) or to your Amazon account (as Amazon Pay balance).

heading_path: Returns and Replacements - FAQ > 4. Where can I check the status of my return?
text:
## 4. Where can I check the status of my return?

To check the status of your return/refund:

1. Access Your Orders.
2. Locate the order which you have returned and select Return/Refund status.
3. You can also manage your Returns from the Returns Center.

heading_path: Returns and Replacements - FAQ > 5. How can I return a Gift?
text:
## 5. How can I return a Gift?

For items eligible for refund or replacement as per return policy, you can also return the gift item in exchange for an Amazon Pay Gift Card (if the gift sender has sent a Gift Receipt to you). For guidance on returning a gift item using a gift receipt, visit [Gift Receipts](send-a-gift-receipt.md).
scope_reason: gift orders are out of scope for this agent

heading_path: Returns and Replacements - FAQ > 6. How can I return a Gift Card?
text:
## 6. How can I return a Gift Card?

Gift cards once purchased cannot be cancelled or returned due to regulatory restrictions.

Please refer to the Amazon Pay Gift Card page to know more about adding gift card balance to your account, redeeming a Gift card and restrictions.

heading_path: Returns and Replacements - FAQ > 7. Can my order be replaced?
text:
## 7. Can my order be replaced?

You may request a replacement if your item:

- Arrives damaged or defective
- Doesn't match the product description on our website
- Is missing parts or accessories

It will be eligible for a free replacement if the product is available with the same seller. Visit Amazon.in [Replacement Policy](replacement-policy.md) to learn more.

To know more about replacing Damaged/Defective products, visit [Damaged, Defective Item FAQs](damaged-or-defective-item.md).

heading_path: Returns and Replacements - FAQ > 8. Can the replacement be delivered to a different address?
text:
## 8. Can the replacement be delivered to a different address?

Replacements cannot be delivered to a different address. We recommend returning the item for a refund (if the product is eligible for return) and place a new order with the new address.

heading_path: Returns and Replacements - FAQ > 9. What can I do if I receive a wrong item?
text:
## 9. What can I do if I receive a wrong item?

You can return or request for replacement of the wrong item. Please ensure the item is in its original condition, and still in its packaging to be eligible for a return. For more information, you can refer to the Help page: [Wrong Product Delivered](wrong-product-delivered.md).

heading_path: Returns and Replacements - FAQ > 10. How can I request a refund for the standard shipping charge?
text:
## 10. How can I request a refund for the standard shipping charge?

If your original order was below ₹499, a ₹40 shipping fee applies. Since the replacement is sent via standard shipping and the original order didn't qualify for free shipping, the charge is non-refundable.

heading_path: Returns and Replacements - FAQ > 11. How can I request a refund for a refund/return due to missing warranty card/user manual in the package?
text:
## 11. How can I request a refund for a refund/return due to missing warranty card/user manual in the package?

A refund or replacement isn't required for missing warranty cards or manuals. The invoice is sufficient to claim the warranty. You can check if these items are included by reviewing the "Included Components" or "What's in the Box" section, and the warranty card note under "About the Item" on the product page.

> **Note:** This applies only to Large Appliances, Home Entertainment products, and Air Coolers.

heading_path: Amazon.in Returns Policy
text:
# Amazon.in Returns Policy

> Information on return eligibility, timelines and other terms & conditions for items purchased on Amazon.in.

Most items purchased from sellers listed on Amazon.in are returnable within the return window, except those that are explicitly identified as not returnable.

For the products that are returned by the customer, the refund is issued to the original payment method (in case of pre-paid transactions) or to the bank account / as Amazon Pay balance (in case of Pay on Delivery orders), the details for making such refund and the timelines are detailed in the refund policy available [here](refund-policy.md).

heading_path: Amazon.in Returns Policy > General Returns Policy
text:

heading_path: Amazon.in Returns Policy > General Returns Policy

heading_path: Amazon.in Returns Policy > General Returns Policy

text:

heading_path: Amazon.in Returns Policy > General Returns Policy

heading_path: Amazon.in Returns Policy > General Returns Policy
text:
## General Returns Policy

17. You may exchange an item for a different size or color (subject to availability on the app/website) or opt for a full refund. To be eligible, items must be returned in their original condition (with the brand outer box, MRP tags attached, warranty cards, and all original accessories in manufacturer packaging).

> **Note:** If you've received a non-returnable product in a damaged/defective condition, you can contact us within 5 days from the delivery of the product.

heading_path: Amazon.in Returns Policy > Return Policy Types with Descriptions

heading_path: Send a Gift Receipt
text:
# Send a Gift Receipt

> Send a gift receipt by following these steps. By sending a gift receipt, the gift receiver can return or choose to view their gift details.

To send a gift receipt to a gift recipient, do one of the following:

1. While placing the order, select the "This order contains a gift" checkbox (for items Fulfilled by Amazon and selected sellers).
2. Select Proceed to checkout.
3. Select Add Gift Options
4. Select This item is a gift and Email a copy of your gift message upon delivery.
5. Enter the recipient's email address and select Save gift options and continue.

heading_path: Send a Gift Receipt > Send a gift receipt for items not marked as a gift after checkout
text:
## Send a gift receipt for items not marked as a gift after checkout

1. Go to Your orders.
2. Find the item and select Share gift receipt.
3. Select the link provided.

Now, you can send this link as gift receipt to the recipient (for example through email, chat, SMS or any other). You can also download a PDF copy of the gift receipt on the website. However, you cannot download a PDF copy in the Amazon shopping app.

> **Note:**
>
> Recipients will be able to see the gift receipt, return options, and have the choice to digitally view their gift, once the order has been delivered.
>
> You can only create gift receipts within the eligible return window for the item. If the option to create a gift receipt isn't available, the item isn't eligible for a return. See [Return a Gift](return-a-gift.md) for more information regarding gift returns.

# Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ

> Information on replacement eligibility, brand contact details and other terms & conditions for items purchased on Amazon.in. Amazon is an online marketplace and the resolution for defective items will be provided by the brand/service centre according to their policies.

page_title: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ
heading_path: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ > 1. What is the Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy?
text:
## 1. What is the Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy?

For issues related to defective items received by a customer, Amazon does not have a provision for processing replacements or refunds to customers. The customer must reach out to the brand/service centre for further resolutions (repair, replacement, warranty, etc.) according to the brand warranty policy. Amazon is an online marketplace facilitating buyer seller discovery for these products.

page_title: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ
heading_path: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ > 2. Which items are eligible for Service Centre Replacement Policy?
text:
## 2. Which items are eligible for Service Centre Replacement Policy?

All products that have "X days Service Centre Replacement" tag on the product page of the item come under this return policy. It is not applicable for Renewed/Refurbished products.

page_title: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ
heading_path: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ > 3. Is this policy applicable for new products that are defective?
text:
## 3. Is this policy applicable for new products that are defective?

Yes. This policy is applicable to all new products purchased on Amazon that have "X days Service Centre Replacement" tag (available to view on the product page before purchase).

page_title: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ
heading_path: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ > 4. What return reasons come under Service Centre Replacement Policy?
text:
## 4. What return reasons come under Service Centre Replacement Policy?

Only Defective return reasons come under the Service Centre Replacement Policy. For all other return reasons, please check the Returns and Orders Page for available resolutions.

page_title: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ
heading_path: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ > 5. Does Amazon provide any post purchase support on these products?
text:
## 5. Does Amazon provide any post purchase support on these products?

Yes. Amazon provides (1) Remote Troubleshooting assistance for these products (available in the Returns and Orders Page through self-help guides) or you may call Amazon customer care and a technical agent will help you with troubleshooting. (2) Customer Door Step Troubleshooting for specific products and pin codes wherein an Amazon Technician will visit you and help with troubleshooting. This option is available to choose in the Returns and Orders Page or you may call Amazon customer care and a technical agent will help you with scheduling a technician visit. Please note, Amazon can only provide troubleshooting assistance but cannot process any returns/refunds/replacements for these defective products.

page_title: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ
heading_path: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ > 6. How will the Brand/Service Centre assist me?
text:
## 6. How will the Brand/Service Centre assist me?

Brand will help you troubleshoot any defect or performance related issue which is covered under product warranty as per their policy. You can contact the brand over their contact no. or email using brand contact details. If the issue is not resolved over the call or email, you may have to visit the nearest brand service center. Brand will provide you with a resolution as per their policy which could include either repairing the product or providing a replacement or other resolutions which are defined under the brand warranty policy at their discretion.

page_title: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ
heading_path: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ > 7. Can Brands repair the new product purchased from Amazon?
text:
## 7. Can Brands repair the new product purchased from Amazon?

Yes. Brands may repair the product or provide a suitable resolution according to their warranty policy.

page_title: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ
heading_path: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ > 8. Where do I find the brand contact details and service centre details?
text:
## 8. Where do I find the brand contact details and service centre details?

- 8.1 Brand Manufacturer Detail Page. The complete list of brands with information on contact number, working hours, email, support website and service centre details is available.
- 8.2 Get Product Support page in the Returns and Orders Page gives the information of the brand details and the nearest service centre details basis your pin code.

page_title: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ
heading_path: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ > 9. How do I access the Get Product Support Page?
text:
## 9. How do I access the Get Product Support Page?

- Step 1: Go to your Profile.
  - On Phone: Profile icon on top right corner or "You" tab at the bottom of the page
  - On Desktop: Returns & Orders on top right corner
- Step 2: Go to your orders.
- Step 3: Select the Item to open the order details page.
- Step 4: Select Get Product Support and click "Available Support options" under the "Warranty claims and Repairs" section.
- Step 5: Clicking on "Available Support options" opens the Warranty section. Here you will find the brand contact information and service centre details. Click on service centres.
- Step 6: Clicking on "Service Centres" shows the available list of service centres in customers location.

page_title: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ
heading_path: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ > 10. How do I download the invoice and warranty?
text:
## 10. How do I download the invoice and warranty?

- Step 1: Go to your Profile.
  - On Phone: Profile icon on top right corner or "You" tab at the bottom of the page
  - On Desktop: Returns & Orders on top right corner
- Step 2: Go to your orders.
- Step 3: Select the Item to open the order details page.
- Step 4: Click on the Invoice button to download the invoice.

page_title: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ
heading_path: Amazon.in Service Centre Replacement Policy - FAQ > 11. Brand/Service Centre has provided me a DOA certificate/service denial letter. What do I do?
text:
## 11. Brand/Service Centre has provided me a DOA certificate/service denial letter. What do I do?

In case of DOA or service denial letter approved by brand, share the certificate of approval to the Amazon customer support team to process your complaint.

page_title: Return orders placed with a Third-party (Marketplace) seller
heading_path: Return orders placed with a Third-party (Marketplace) seller > Before You Return - Important Guidelines
text:
## Before You Return - Important Guidelines

- You must contact the seller within the applicable return window as mentioned in Amazon.in [Returns Policy](returns-policy.md).
- When you order from a marketplace seller who fulfills and delivers the product, your return is sent directly back to the seller. Return policies may vary between different sellers. You can view the seller's return policy on the seller profile page before purchasing an item.
- To return a seller-fulfilled order, raise a return request with the seller. Once the return is approved by the seller, arrange for the return pick-up with the seller.

text:
## How to Return a Seller-Fulfilled Order

- Choose the appropriate option and initiate the conversation.

text:
## What is A-to-Z Guarantee claim?

The Amazon A-to-Z Guarantee protects customers when they purchase items sold and shipped by a third-party seller who provides their own customer service directly to you.

A customer is eligible to file an A-to-Z Guarantee claim if:

- They have purchased physical goods which were sold and shipped by a third-party seller on the Amazon.in marketplace.
- AND in case of any issue, they have contacted the seller through their Amazon account and waited 48 hours for a reply.
- For more information on the eligibility criteria, visit [A-to-Z Guarantee help page](a-to-z-guarantee.md).

> **Note:** If the seller does not provide enough information to return your items or fails to address your query in 48 hours, you may file an A-to-Z Guarantee claim to seek help with your return.

# Wrong Product Delivered

> Have you received a wrong product? Resolve the issue through the frequently asked questions below.

heading_path: Wrong Product Delivered > 1. How to identify a wrong item?
text:
## 1. How to identify a wrong item?

To confirm if a wrong item was delivered to you, go to Your Orders. Check the product description and compare the details with the item you have received. If there is a mismatch in colour, size, fabric, design, model, or type, you have most probably received a wrong product.

> **Note:** Based on stock availability, certain items are delivered in different colours from the picture shown in the product description page. If this variation is mentioned in the product description page, this will not be considered as a wrong item.

heading_path: Wrong Product Delivered > 2. What can I do if I receive a wrong item?
text:
## 2. What can I do if I receive a wrong item?

You can return or request a replacement of the wrong item. Please ensure the item is in its original condition to be eligible for a return. For more information, you can refer to the Help page: [Amazon Return Policy](returns-policy.md).

heading_path: Wrong Product Delivered > 3. How do I initiate a return/ replacement for the wrong item?
text:
## 3. How do I initiate a return/ replacement for the wrong item?

Return/ exchange can only be requested within the return window of the product. Check the product details page to know if the order is eligible for return/ replacement.

- Go to Your Orders.
- Select the product that you want to replace.
- Click on Return/ Replace items.
- Choose a reason to replace.
- Continue and proceed as per the on-screen instructions.
- For more details on scheduling a return, refer to the page [How to schedule a Returns](how-to-schedule-a-return.md).

**Note:**

heading_path: Wrong Product Delivered > 3. How do I initiate a return/ replacement for the wrong item?
text:
## 3. How do I initiate a return/ replacement for the wrong item?

1. For non-returnable products, we might require a clear image for verifying that the product is damaged or defective. Visit the [Add Photos: Frequently Asked Questions](add-photos-faq.md) page to learn how to upload images.
2. Item will be picked up as per the scheduled pickup date and time, which will be communicated via email and visible in Your Orders.
3. If your address is not covered by our courier partners, you will need to return the item using any courier. Visit [Return Pick-up and Self-Ship Guidelines](return-pickup-and-self-ship.md) to learn more.

heading_path: Wrong Product Delivered > 3. How do I initiate a return/ replacement for the wrong item? > Replacement/ Exchange
text:
### Replacement/ Exchange

An exchange can be processed only if the stock is available with the same seller.

Once an exchange is requested, the new product will be shipped after original item is returned to us, or if it has been picked up by us for a return.

An exchange can only be requested once on the original order.

In case the exchange item's cost is more or less than the original item, we will neither charge nor refund the customer as the exchange order will be created with zero value similar to replacements.

heading_path: Wrong Product Delivered > 4. What is the time frame for returning a wrong item?
text:
## 4. What is the time frame for returning a wrong item?

The time window for initiating a replacement is the same as the return window for that product category. For example, if the product has a return window of 30 days, a replacement will also have to be initiated within the same period of 30 days. Visit [Replacement Policy](replacement-policy.md) to learn more.

heading_path: Wrong Product Delivered > 5. What if I had kept the wrong item for a longer period before realizing?
text:
## 5. What if I had kept the wrong item for a longer period before realizing?

Unfortunately, we will not be able to process a return / replacement request once the window is over.

heading_path: Wrong Product Delivered > 6. Do I have to pay for return shipping?
text:
## 6. Do I have to pay for return shipping?

Return Shipping charges are applicable only when customer self-ships the product. The amount will be refunded once the item (in its original state) is returned to us and the quality check is complete.

heading_path: Wrong Product Delivered > 7. When will I receive a refund for the wrong item?
text:
## 7. When will I receive a refund for the wrong item?

Allow up to 10 days for the returned item to reach our fulfillment center. Upon receiving your return, our team will conduct a thorough inspection. Once we are satisfied with our inspection, your refund will be processed within 5 business days. If you haven't received your refund after 13 days, you can contact Customer Service. The refund will be issued to the original payment method used for the order.

> **Note:** We recommend you complete the KYC process for a smooth completion of the refund process. You can do KYC verification via Digilocker or manual national ID upload and a selfie.
>
> Digilocker provides instant verification using One-Time Password. The manual document upload is verified manually and is processed within one business day.
>
> Accepted documents include a driving licence, passport, voter ID, and PAN Card.

## 8. What to do when I receive someone else's order?

If you receive a package or item that you didn't order, first confirm that it was not a gift that was sent to you. Check with friends and family to find out if they ordered the package. If you confirm that the package addressed to you wasn't ordered by you or anyone you know, report the package by contacting us.

To know more, check the Help page: [Received Someone Else's Order](received-someone-elses-order.md).
